# Vendored on-device Hebrew TTS: licences

Everything here is served from this site. Nothing is fetched from third parties at runtime.

| Component | File(s) | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.1 (WASM build) | `ort/` | MIT, © Microsoft Corporation | npm `onnxruntime-web` |
| renikud Hebrew G2P (text → stressed IPA) | `models/renikud.onnx`, `models/renikud-meta.json` (metadata extracted from the model) | CC BY 4.0, © Maxim Melichov, Yakov Kolani, Morris Alper | huggingface.co/renikud/renikud |
| Piper Hebrew voice "noa" (medium, VITS, 22.05 kHz) | `models/he_IL-noa-medium.onnx(.json)` | CC BY 4.0, © thewh1teagle | huggingface.co/thewh1teagle/piper-he-noa |

CC BY 4.0 requires attribution, which this file and the app's About section provide. Commercial use is permitted.
The noa voice was trained on synthetic speech generated with Chatterbox (MIT) from Knesset sentences.
Before any production use, review the upstream terms again.

We did NOT use facebook/mms-tts-heb, which is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial only).
